item.title: Here’s Why “Inertia Coupling” Is So Dangerous to Fighter Pilots
item.description: Normally, a plane moves along three rotational axes. “Inertia coupling” takes place when the plane inadvertently moves on two at the same time, usually resulting in loss of control. The post Here’s Why “Inertia Coupling” Is So Dangerous to Fighter Pilots appeared first on The National Interest.

item.title: Here’s How Anti-Submarine Planes Actually Work
item.description: Spotter planes can no longer directly see enemy submarines. Today, their mission is overwhelmingly acoustic—listening to signals from submarines and narrowing down their likely position before taking action.
